title: European Certificate in Essentials in Rare and Undiagnosed Diseases (EC RUD)
description: Official current abbreviation is EC RUD, not CERUD. This is a credential, not a preparatory course. Eligibility includes a valid medical qualification, documented rare-disease care and training aligned at least 80% with the latest European Training Requirements. The organizer’s PDF contains an internal wording inconsistency about exam parts, so the live organizer page should be rechecked before publication.
